page.notes: Two printed columns, one page (487). The gutter line numbers (10, 20 ... 60) are kept as notes beside the left column. Left column ends "ar-" and the right column begins "gumento", so the word runs over the column break. Doubtful readings: "ap-" at the end of the left column may be "ar-"; several words in the right column are set in a worn, irregular type (e.g. "Vuitteb ergesis", "Louanien", "Eleetorem", "Elestorem") and are copied as printed. The bracketed "[" before "Porrò" is printed as such. The final word of the right column "Ele-" is a hyphenated break and is written as printed ("Ele-"), and is closed "Elestorem" in the continuation on the next page.
